title: 생방 3초
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and City Pop fusion. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated funk-style muted strums and arpeggiated chords. A slap bass guitar performs a rhythmic line with frequent octaves and slides. Electronic drums feature a crisp snare and a steady kick. Bright, polyphonic synthesizer pads and staccato synth brass stabs punctuate the arrangement. Female vocals are delivered in a melodic, rhythmic style with light reverb. The track is in the key of E Major at 115 BPM in 4/4 time.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar arpeggios, slap bass, electronic drums]
